subject: Integration follow-up: SDK auth + embeddings reranker 5xx errors
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex@finlytics.com>
Cc: Finlytics Engineering <eng@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Integration follow-up: SDK auth + embeddings reranker 5xx errors

Alex 

great talk earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Observation: you mentioned seeing intermittent 5xx errors when calling the embeddings + reranker pipeline after upgrading to our v0.9 SDK.
- Scope: SDK setup (auth header method), routing to the reranker model, and structured/tool-calling outputs.
- Immediate asks: 1) can you share a minimal repro payload that triggers the 5xx? 2) are you using API key in Authorization: Bearer <key> or the SDK native auth flow? 3) any region-specific routing (e.g., custom x-redwood-routing headers)?

I've attached a short repro_payload.json example (can you confirm if your payload is similar?). I'll loop in Eng for triage (cc'ing them).

Next step: if you can send the exact request + a timestamp of a failing call, our engineers will repro against staging and propose a fix (likely quick). Also happy to hop on a 30-min call if that accelerates.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: repro_payload.json (sample request payload)

From: Alex Reynolds <alex@finlytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finlytics Engineering <eng@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration follow-up: SDK auth + embeddings reranker 5xx errors

Thanks Neha — we reproduced the failure and attached a minimal payload as requested. Key details: 

- Timestamp of failing call: 2026-03-17T09:28:14Z
- Endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer (via SDK v0.9, Node)
- Auth: Authorization: Bearer <our-api-key> (we're using the env-based API key flow)
- Request: see attached repro_payload.json (includes inputs for embeddings -> reranker).
- Error: intermittent 500 with response body: {"error":"internal_server_error","message":"unexpected null in tool_call parser"}

We also see a spike in latency prior to the 500s (~1.2s -> 6s) and then the 500. We can grant temporary read-only API key to your team if that helps repro in our account.

Best,
Alex Reynolds
Principal Product Manager | Finlytics
alex@finlytics.com

Attachment: repro_payload.json

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Integration follow-up: SDK auth + embeddings reranker 5xx errors

Hi team — forwarding Finlytics' repro and logs. They supplied a minimal payload and timestamps. Can you triage and confirm repro in staging? Key asks: 

- Reproduce the 500 and identify the failure surface (auth/routing/parser/runtime)
- Check if SDK v0.9 has known regression for structured/tool_call outputs
- Quick mitigation: if this is parser-related, suggest a safe runtime fallback (return structured error instead of 500)

I attached our collected SDK logs from the user session (redwood_sdk_logs.zip) and matched the failing timestamp. Let me know ETA and whether I should coordinate a short triage call with Finlytics.

Thanks,
Neha

Attachment: redwood_sdk_logs.zip

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Integration follow-up: SDK auth + embeddings reranker 5xx errors

Thanks Neha — initial look at the repro + logs. Quick notes from triage attempt against staging: 

- Auth: header method (Authorization: Bearer ...) is fine; we reproduced requests using a temporary test key.
- Routing: noticed the client did not send x-redwood-routing header. By default it routes to the generic reranker variant; there is a chance model-variant mismatch causes parser edge-case. Worth validating exactly which reranker variant Finlytics expects.

- Payload: their JSON includes a null in the tool_call.output field in a few items (see repro payload). Our structured output parser currently assumes tool_call.output is non-null in some code paths — that leads to an uncaught NPE in the parser and surfaced as 500.
- Short mitigation to try: increase request-level timeout to 30s and add a defensive validation in SDK that sanitizes null tool_call fields before sending. Can Finlytics try a quick run with timeout=30000ms?

Action items: 
- Jonas: can you reproduce locally and add a test for null tool_call.output?
- Marissa: can you propose a rollback/patch that returns a structured 4xx validation error instead of 500 if parser sees nulls?

I'll craft suggested request snippet below to share with Finlytics: 

--- suggested client changes ---
{
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <key>",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "x-redwood-routing": "reranker-v1"
  },
  timeout: 30000
}

Vivek
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Integration follow-up: SDK auth + embeddings reranker 5xx errors

Reproduced locally against staging with the provided payload. Findings: 

- Root cause: our tool_call parser (pkg/toolparser) expects a properties map to exist when tool_call.output is present. The repro payload had tool_call:{"name":"lookup_company","output":null} which triggered a nil dereference in parser.walkProperties -> 500.
- Fix: add a guarded check for null/undefined tool_call.output, and convert to explicit {"output": null} handling path that returns a 400 with an error_code: TOOL_CALL_INVALID instead of 500.
- Unit tests: adding tests that assert no crash on null outputs.

Attached stack_trace.txt (short) showing the NPE and callstack.

Next steps: push hotfix branch (hotfix/toolcall-null-guard) and stage rollout. I recommend we ask Finlytics to run the suggested client timeout header in parallel to avoid retries piling up. 

Jonas
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Runtime
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: stack_trace.txt

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex@finlytics.com>
Cc: Finlytics Engineering <eng@finlytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration follow-up: SDK auth + embeddings reranker 5xx errors

Alex — quick update and proposed next steps from Eng: 

- Summary: Eng reproduced the 500. Root cause is a null tool_call.output in the request that triggers an uncaught NPE in our structured-output parser. Jonas has a hotfix branch that guards against nulls and returns a 400 with TOOL_CALL_INVALID instead of 500.
- Immediate mitigation for you to try: add header x-redwood-routing: reranker-v1 and set request timeout=30000 (Vivek's suggested snippet). This reduces likelihood of retries stacking and gives us deterministic repros.
- Next steps: 
  1) Can you run one verification call with the updated headers + timeout? If you can, please include the exact timestamp of the call so we can check logs.
  2) We'll stage the hotfix and let you know target rollout time (ETA: next 24-36 hrs).
  3) If verification shows remaining failures, propose a 20-min call Monday to run live debugging.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — appreciate the detailed repro. I'll coordinate the rollout and keep you posted.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
